hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) ruff format --quiet "$f"; ruff check --fix --quiet "$f";; esac; exit 0

if [ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active')" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(OPENAI_API_KEY=dummy python -m pytest -q -x 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
